content.short: BasedApp is a self-custody crypto banking app pairing a non-custodial wallet with a Visa debit card.
content.description: BasedApp connects a non-custodial wallet to a Visa debit card, so balances stay under the user's control until the moment they are spent. Keeping custody right up to the point of payment is the interesting constraint here, given card networks expect an authorisation answer in milliseconds.
content.meta: Spend from a non-custodial wallet on a Visa debit card, with custody kept until the point of payment.
